release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.29 (Build 29) - Enhanced Backup & Restore System:
- Real MongoDB backup implementation - exports actual database collections to JSON files
- Enhanced backup fetching - automatically discovers and displays all existing backups
- Comprehensive backup display - shows all backups grouped by status (Running, Completed, Failed)
- Detailed backup information - displays collections backed up, document counts, and file sizes
- Real-time backup status updates - auto-refresh every 3 seconds for live progress tracking
- Full backup control - restore, delete, and cancel operations for all backup types
- Backup path tracking - stores and displays backup file locations
- Improved backup restoration - full collection restoration with progress tracking
- Enhanced backup scheduling - automated backup creation with flexible scheduling options
- Backup verification - integrity checks and verification status display
- Multi-collection backup support - backs up users, chats, messages, and all system collections
- Backup history management - complete backup lifecycle tracking and management
- Responsive backup UI - optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens
- Error handling improvements - better error messages and recovery for backup operations
- Performance optimizations - efficient backup creation and restoration processes
